notes.title: Warspear Online Update 13.0. Tales of the Desert. Release
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30831945/cad29715dbbf99223d41e47c9ae70ac2c7876e6d.png"]

Warriors!



Get ready to embark on an epic journey into the uncharted lands of Almahad! Brave the scorching dunes, explore long-lost ruins, and uncover the buried secrets of the Valley of Bones. A new non-playable faction – the Mage's Guild – has entered the fray, challenging you to choose your allegiance wisely. Unlock the Mages' unique talents and dive into the brand-new Tower Search feature, where hidden treasures and deadly dangers awai! New challenges and new victories lie ahead – are you ready?



What's new in Update 13.0 - Tales of the Desert:



NEW REGION: VALLEY OF BONES

Immersive story quests

Unique bosses of the Valley of Bones

New trade routes with the Silver Dirham merchant

NEW NPC FACTION: THE MAGE'S GUILD

Daily and dynamic quests

Earn reputation with the Elders of the Mage's Guild

Unlock special Mage talents

Explore the brand-new Tower Search system

Earn cumulative rewards for each Tower explored

NEW GAME MODE: THE CATACOMBS

Time-limited party-based PvPvE dungeons

Unique reward mechanics

Level 34 heroic equipment with set bonuses that grant special skills

EXPANDED CONTENT ON ALMAHAD ISLAND

New talents for Adventurers and Assassins

New Tombs and Outposts

New cumulative rewards in Towers, Tombs and Outposts

New individual and legendary achievements

New abilities available from the Crimson Corundum merchant

New PvE and PvP gear

Activity Season & Battle Pass

Exclusive daily rewards

New items in the Miracle Shop

OTHER CHANGES

New tutorial tooltips in the Character > Skills menu

Improved UI of the Character > Skills menu


We greatly appreciate your excitement for the upcoming game mode – Catacombs! Full details on its mechanics and the complete reward list will be published in separate release notes, so stay tuned for updates! Planned opening date for the Catacombs: October 2, 2025.



Get the full details here!

notes.title: Warspear Online Update 13.0. Tales of the Desert. Announcement. Part II
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30831945/baa2a98bc31f47c4a8f2e1cb111ed9ffe1edf0eb.png"]

Warriors!



Your journey into the uncharted lands of Almahad is about to begin! Prepare to cross scorching, windswept dunes, uncover forgotten ruins, and explore ancient mysteries buried deep within catacombs and sanctuaries lost to time. This expedition marks the start of countless new discoveries – and it's your actions that will shape the tales told of the heroes who walk the Island of the Chainless League!



As the river of time flows ever onward, the threads of human fate weave into an ever more intricate tapestry. The city of Er-Sahil flourishes, and the skies over Almahad now shine with new stars. Where once two mighty stars shared the heavens, a third star has risen: the Mage's Guild, having reached the height of its power, now stands as an equal alongside the formidable Adventurer's Guild and Assassin's Guild.



The announcement is now live on the Forum!

notes.title: Warspear Online Update 13.0. Tales of the Desert. Announcement. Part I
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30831945/baa2a98bc31f47c4a8f2e1cb111ed9ffe1edf0eb.png"]

Warriors of Arinar!



The adventurers of Almahad know well that the Golden Sands conceal both hidden wonders and deadly snares. Few have ever dared to set foot on the Hill of the Black Sun – an ancient frontier echoing with the remnants of long-lost civilizations. Legends whisper that those who reach its peak will face a trial unlike any encountered before...



Buried beneath the dunes and ancient foundations lies a sprawling labyrinth: the Catacombs of Almahad. Any soul bold enough to enter should remember one truth: descending into the Catacombs is only half the battle – escaping in time is the true challenge.



Let's prepare for a run into the Catacombs!



Get the full details here!

Sorcerers and Sorceresses of Arinar!

The school year at the School of Magic is almost over! To mark this magical milestone, the Spring King has announced Spring Bounty Week! It's the perfect time to jump in and score some epic loot!

 The Mirrored Vesperian, Alois Foss, and Twisted Dryad costumes can now drop in all holiday Dungeons (with higher drop rates in higher-level dungeons)
 The rarest non-class Book of Enhanced Skill Cooldown can now drop in the House of Secrets V, House of Secrets VI, and House of Secrets VII holiday Dungeons (with higher drop rates in higher-level dungeons)
 x2 drop rate for unique weapons with the Attack Strength bonus in all holiday Dungeons
 x2 drop rate for rare weapons with doubled bonuses in all holiday Dungeons
 x2 drop rate for unique accessories (rings, bracelets, amulets, cloaks) with Physical/Magic Power and bonuses to Skill Cooldown and Attack Strength in all holiday Dungeons
 Costumes can now drop from the Treasuries in all holiday Dungeons:
 Spellfighting Apprentice's/Expert's Treasury: Light Sorcerer and Light Sorceress
 Dark Magizoology Apprentice's/Expert's Treasury: Reflection Sorcerer and Reflection Sorceress
 Unique cloaks with Physical/Magic Power and bonuses to Skill Cooldown and Attack Strength can now drop from the Treasuries in all holiday Dungeons:
 Spellfighting Expert's Treasury: Level 6, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32 Cloaks (scaling with dungeon level)
 Dark Magizoology Expert's Treasury: Level 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34 Cloaks (scaling with dungeon level)

Get ready for even more excitement on the Blissful Isle! This week, you'll have twice as many chances to earn epic loot, so there's no better time to dive in! Take on fearsome raid bosses, join the action in world and guild events, and gather your guild for the holiday Guild Tournament!

 x2 drop rate for the Alexis costume and the non-class Book of Physical Toughening from the Blissful Isle world boss Alexis
 x2 drop rate for the Sullen Polkan costume and the non-class Book of Magical Toughening from the Blissful Isle world boss Sullen Polkan
 x2 drop rate for the Swampy Bogmuck costume from Coffers for the Live Practice holiday world event
 x2 drop rate for the Owlbear costume and the non-class Book of Enhanced Attack Strength from the Treasury for the Trials of Valor holiday guild event
 x2 drop rate for the Scrollbinder costume and the non-class Book of Rampant Attack from the Jewelry Box for the Book Maze holiday guild event
 x2 drop rate for the non-class Book of Combat Agility from the Chest for the holiday Spring King's Tournament

You'll also have the chance to earn more event currency, gain extra reputation points, and triple the Guild Points!

For this week only, we're waiving the usual requirement of completing the School of Magic to gain access to the reputation shop of Magister Avaris! Even if you haven't completed the Spellfighting and Dark Magizoology courses, you'll still be able to spend your reputation in his shop!

Heroes of the Blissful Isle will also have the opportunity to compete for one of the top 10 winning spots in the Guild Tournament, which will count toward the Non-Fading Glory achievement:

Ranks 1-3: x2 Crimson Corundum for winning the Guild Tournament
Ranks 4-10: All guild members receive Crimson Corundum and Bronze Coffer x1

Event and tournament duration: 05.05 13:00 CEST – 12.05 12:00 CEST

And there's still more! Head over to the Miracle Shop for a limited-time 50% off the New and Noteworthy section! Don't miss your chance to grab the Duck Tales, Toads, and Pirate Gang smiley packs, plus the exclusive Blissful Isle Vintage Chest!

notes.title: Activity Season 33: Hour of the Omen!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30831945/958c20b1254d702fdf8772c9e7d8ac593b996fdb.png

Warriors!

The new Activity Season is almost here, marking the beginning of a thrilling era of glorious adventures and unforgettable triumphs for the heroes of Arinar!

The Activity Center is packed with daily and weekly missions, carefully designed to match your character's level. Remember that daily missions will reset at 00:00 CEST each day, and any progress made on incomplete missions will be lost. This also applies to weekly missions, which reset every Monday at 00:00 CEST.

Get ready to discover this season's rewards! For your heroic feats, you'll be able to earn the enigmatic Stormborn costume, the legendary Dragon Impetuosity skill, unique minions, sunny hairstyles, and new exclusive smileys! There are also Signs of Imperishability, Legendary Elixirs of Unity and Experience, keys to Pirate and Tribal Chests, Knowledge, and much more – including the Chest of Impunity!
Inside these chests, you'll find:

Books:

 Book of Second Chance
 Book of Underground Speed

Book of Second Chance
Immediately resurrects the character's minion and applies Invulnerability to it for 10 sec once per lifetime. An extra life is indicated by the icon next to the minion's health/energy bar.

Book of Underground Speed
Increases the character's movement speed in dungeons by 10%.

Costumes:

 Black Troll Costume
 Blue Troll Costume
 Green Troll Costume
 Red Troll Costume
 Purple Troll Costume
 Pink Troll Costume

Eternal Forest and Cursed Lands Decorative Skins

Unique Empowering Relics:

 Icy Relic of Intractability
 Magic Relic of Resilience
 Terrible Relic of Control

Icy Relic of Intractability
Adds 40% to the skill's effect when used under Rage.

Magic Relic of Resilience
Adds 40% to the skill's effect when the character's health drops below 30% of maximum health.

Terrible Relic of Control
Increases the duration of the skill's effect by 25% with a chance equal to Health Steal.

And also:

 Great Gladiator's, Unity, and Experience Elixirs
 Special Battle Scrolls
 Powerful Potions
 Precious Bars

Dragon Impetuosity Skill
Unleash the legendary speed of a mythical dragon and race through the lands of Arinar! Cannot be used in guild events, sieges, Arenas, and underwater. Available until the end of the Activity Season.

For all those looking to get the most out of every mission, the Battle Pass unlocks an additional reward track with even more prizes! And that's not all – Battle Pass holders also gain access to:

 More daily and weekly mission slots
 Quick access to the Personal and Guild Storage
 Free hairstyle changes at the Personal Hairdresser
 Personal Knowledge Bank

On top of that, once you have redeemed all of your season rewards, the Battle Pass will unlock an additional reward slot containing a Chest of Impunity for every 40 points earned! Best of all, you can redeem this chest over and over again until the end of the season!

Also, don't miss out on the opportunity to gift the Battle Pass to any character level 6 or higher within your Alliance and game realm! Try it out right from the Activity Center!

The new Activity Season begins on April 28, 00:00 CEST, and lasts through June 9, 00:00 CEST.

See you in the game!
The Warspear Online Team

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30831945/453002c4f4c8b983be783f04ff28a28c95381f4a.png

Warriors!

This spring, the Blissful Isle is brimming with excitement! While mastering their skills at the School of Magic, the heroes of Arinar will embark on thrilling adventures and uncover rare treasures on this holiday island. And with the new Activity Season just around the corner, exploring its magical secrets will be even more fun!

The Activity Center is packed with daily and weekly missions, carefully designed to match your character's level. Remember that daily missions will reset at 23:00 CET each day, and any progress made on incomplete missions will be lost. This also applies to weekly missions, which reset every Sunday at 23:00 CET.

Extraordinary rewards await brave adventurers this season! Among the treasures are the mystical Magicus costume, the marvelous Owl Impetuosity skill, unique minions, mighty buffs such as Great Magic Wisdom Buff, Magic Mood's Chest with exclusive smileys, and spring hairstyles! You'll also have the chance to claim Magic Grains, additional storage slots, Signs of Imperishability, and much more – including the legendary Blissful Isle Chest!

Inside these chests, you'll find:

Books:

 Book of Second Chance
 Book of Underground Speed

Book of Second Chance
Immediately resurrects the character's minion and applies Invulnerability to it for 10 sec once per lifetime. An extra life is indicated by the icon next to the minion's health/energy bar.

Book of Underground Speed
Increases the character's movement speed in dungeons by 10%.

Costumes:

Heraldic Lily Decorative Skins

Unique Empowering Relics:

 Magic Relic of Resilience

Adds 40% to the skill's effect when the character's health drops below 30% of maximum health.

And also:

 Great Gladiator's, Unity, and Experience Elixirs
 Special Battle Scrolls
 Powerful Potions
 Precious Bars

Owl Impetuosity Skill
Experience the grace, agility, stealth, and silence, hallmarking the enigmatic night hunter. Explore Arinar under the guise of the fabled predator! Cannot be used in guild events, sieges, Arenas, and underwater. Available until the end of the Activity Season.

Great Magic Wisdom Buff
Increases the character's reputation gain with the Magisters of Spellfighting and Dark Magizoology by 20%.Lasts until the end of the Activity Season.This effect does not stack.

For all those looking to pack their loot bags with the treasures of the Blissful Isle, be sure to activate the Battle Pass! It unlocks an additional branch of unique trophies and many other perks:

 More daily and weekly mission slots
 Quick access to the Personal and Guild Storage
 Free hairstyle changes at the Personal Hairdresser
 Personal Knowledge Bank

On top of that, once you have redeemed all of your season rewards, the Battle Pass will unlock an additional reward slot containing a Blissful Isle Chest for every 40 points earned! Best of all, you can redeem this chest over and over again until the end of the season!

Also, don't miss out on the opportunity to gift the Battle Pass to any character level 6 or higher within your Alliance and game realm! Try it out right from the Activity Center!

The new Activity Season begins on March 16, 23:00 CET, and lasts through April 27, 23:00 CET!

See you in the game!

Warriors!

Dive into thrilling adventures across the vast realm of Arinar and make the frosty days of February unforgettable! Get ready to challenge lurking monsters, prove your heroism, and earn exclusive rewards in the brand-new Activity Season coming soon!

The Activity Center is packed with daily and weekly missions, carefully designed to match your character's level. Extraordinary rewards await brave adventurers this season! Among the treasures are the mystical Demon costume, the incredible Star Guide skill, unique minions, useful buffs, new exclusive smileys, and festival hairstyles! You'll also find reputation boosts with the Elders of the Adventurer's and Assassin's Guild, additional storage slots, Signs of Imperishability, keys to Pirate and Tribal Chests, and much more – including the legendary Chest of Impunity!

Inside these chests, you'll find:

Books:

 Book of Second Chance
 Book of Underground Speed

Book of Second Chance
Immediately resurrects the character's minion and applies Invulnerability to it for 10 sec once per lifetime. An extra life is indicated by the icon next to the minion's health/energy bar.

Book of Underground Speed
Increases the character's movement speed in dungeons by 10%.

Eternal Forest and Cursed Lands Decorative Skins

Icy Relic of Intractability
Adds 40% to the skill's effect when used under Rage.

Magic Relic of Resilience
Adds 40% to the skill's effect when the character's health drops below 30% of maximum health.

Terrible Relic of Control
Increases the duration of the skill's effect by 25% with a chance equal to Health Steal.

And also:

 Great Gladiator's, Unity, and Experience Elixirs

Star Guide Skill
Embrace a mystical symbol of serenity and caution, allowing you to roam Arinar with a unique blend of grace, finesse, and agility. Cannot be used in guild events, sieges, Arenas, and underwater. Available until the end of the Activity Season.

For all those looking to pack their loot bags with some valuable items, be sure to activate the Battle Pass! It unlocks a range of unique trophies and many other perks:

 More daily and weekly mission slots

On top of that, once you have redeemed all of your season rewards, the Battle Pass will unlock an additional reward slot containing a Chest of Impunity for every 40 points earned! Best of all, you can redeem this chest over and over again until the end of the season!

notes.title: Activity Season 29: Spooky Spectacle!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30831945/f588c854096330a6e7e2aaf5be2d47e742e79c86.png

Warriors!

An exciting new chapter begins in Arinar with the new Activity Season! Embark on an adventurous journey through the eerie Vogelville, try your luck at carnival games, explore dark dungeons for rare treasures, assist Silvan in the world event, battle bloodthirsty monsters, or challenge other players in the Arena. The Activity Center offers missions tailored to each hero's level!

Remember that daily missions will reset at 23:00 CET each day, and any progress made on incomplete missions will be lost. This also applies to weekly missions, which reset every Sunday at 23:00 CET.
Now, let's dive into the rewards of this new season!

Your efforts will be richly rewarded with the mystical Eclipse costume, the eerie Naughty Ride skill, the holiday Chest of Malevolent Smirks full of fun smileys, powerful buffs such as Great Intimidation, Crimson Corundum and Essence of Horror, and new exclusive smileys! There are also mystical hairstyles, Signs of Imperishability, Legendary Elixirs of Unity and Experience, Knowledge, and other rewards, including the Chest of Median Night!

Inside these chests, you'll find:

Books:

 Book of Second Chance
 Book of Underground Speed

Book of Second Chance
Immediately resurrects the character's minion and applies Invulnerability to it for 10 sec once per lifetime. An extra life is indicated by the icon next to the minion's health/energy bar.

Book of Underground Speed
Increases the character's movement speed in dungeons by 10%.

Costumes:

 Petruccio's Garb
 Coviello's Garb
 Punchinello's Garb
 Harlequin's Garb
 Jester's Garb
 Sebastian
 Cruel Uzmak
 Master Tarrinis
 Velorina de Rouen
 Puppeteer
 Alchemist Totenhof
 Baron Saturday
 Hrungnir
 Boogeyman
 Valdemar
 Joker

Unique Empowering Relic:

Terrible Relic of Control
Increases the duration of the skill's effect by 25% with a chance equal to Health Steal.

Eternal Forest and Cursed Lands Decorative Skins

And also:

 Great Gladiator's, Unity, and Experience Elixirs
 Special Battle Scrolls
 Powerful Potions
 Precious Bars

Naughty Ride Skill
Travel through Arinar's most hidden areas quickly and stylishly, with a spooky twist! Cannot be used in guild events, sieges, Arenas, and underwater. Available until the end of the Activity Season.

Great Intimidation Buff
Increases the character's Essence of Horror gain by 20%. Lasts until the end of the Activity Season (does not stack).

For all those looking to pack their loot bags with some valuable items, be sure to activate the Battle Pass! It unlocks a range of unique trophies and many other perks:

 More daily and weekly mission slots
 Quick access to the Personal and Guild Storage
 Free hairstyle changes at the Personal Hairdresser
 Personal Knowledge Bank

On top of that, once you have redeemed all of your season rewards, the Battle Pass will unlock an additional reward slot containing a Chest of Median Night for every 40 points earned! Best of all, you can redeem this chest over and over again until the end of the season!

Also, don't miss out on the opportunity to gift the Battle Pass to any character level 6 or higher within your Alliance and game realm! Try it out right from the Activity Center!

The new Activity Season begins on October 27, 23:00 CET, and lasts through December 8, 23:00 CET.

See you in the game!
The Warspear Online Team

Brave Warriors!

Get ready to journey back to the vast deserts of Almahad and embark on new adventures as the new Activity Season begins!

Explore the sun-drenched lands of Arinar, brave the dark depths of dungeons for hidden treasures, hone your crafting skills, strengthen your guild, battle ferocious monsters, or test your mettle against other players in the Arena. The Activity Center offers a variety of daily and weekly missions for every playstyle and level!

Keep in mind that daily missions will reset at 00:00 CEST each day, and any progress made on incomplete missions will be lost. This also applies to weekly missions, which reset every Monday at 00:00 CEST.

Curious about the rewards awaiting Arinar's heroes this season?
Your valiant efforts will earn you the stunning Simoom costume, the handy Desert Adventurer skill, unique minions, powerful buffs such as Great Elder Reverence, Silver Dirhams, exclusive smileys, seasonal hairstyles, and Signs of Imperishability! There are also Legendary Elixirs of Unity and Experience, Tribal Chest Keys, Knowledge, and other rewards, including the Mysterious East Chest!

Inside these chests, you'll find:

Books:

 Book of Second Chance
 Book of Underground Speed

Book of Second Chance
Immediately resurrects the character's minion and applies Invulnerability to it for 10 sec once per lifetime. An extra life is indicated by the icon next to the minion’s health/energy bar.

Book of Underground Speed
Increases the character's movement speed in dungeons by 10%.

Costumes:

 Tomb Elect
 Outpost Chef
 Tomb Guardian
 Outpost Leader
 Snakeman
 Dog-Head

Eternal Forest and Cursed Lands Decorative Skins

And also:

 Great Gladiator’s, Unity, and Experience Elixirs
 Special Combat Scrolls
 Powerful Potions
 Precious Bars

Desert Adventurer Skill
Embrace the wisdom of the desert to uncover secret paths and reach your destination quickly. Cannot be used in guild events, sieges, Arenas, and underwater. Available until the end of the Activity Season.

Great Elder Reverence Buff
Increases the character's reputation gain with all Almahad factions by 20% (does not stack).

For all those looking to pack their loot bags with some valuable items, be sure to activate the Battle Pass! It unlocks a range of unique trophies and many other perks:

 More daily and weekly mission slots
 Quick access to the Personal and Guild Storage
 Free hairstyle changes at the Personal Hairdresser
 Personal Knowledge Bank

On top of that, once you have redeemed all of your season rewards, the Battle Pass will unlock an additional reward slot containing a Mysterious East Chest for every 40 points earned! Best of all, you can redeem this chest over and over again until the end of the season!

Also, don't miss out on the opportunity to gift the Battle Pass to any character level 6 or higher within your Alliance and game realm! Try it out right from the Activity Center!

The new Activity Season begins on September 9, 00:00 CEST, and lasts through October 28, 00:00 CEST.

Adventure calls!
The Warspear Online Team

News from the Snowy Boundary is troubling: the Ice Citadel is under threat again! Whitebeard and the snow elves had to leave the fortress in a hurry, and now the fierce giantess Gryla controls the sparkling halls of the ice castle. It is necessary to expel the uninvited guest from the Citadel as soon as possible, otherwise there will be no World Creation holiday!

Defeating Gryla will not be so easy, because after the capture of the Citadel, the holiday island was filled with wild animals, mountain trolls and merciless monsters descended from the pages of winter fairy tales. Only the heroes of Arinar will be able to defeat all the monsters and understand the true causes of Gryla's rage!

Dear friends!

In Arinar, the hunting season for rewards comes, because the 12th Season of activities begins on Morsilvania! Not a single brave warrior can remain indifferent to adventures on a festive island and weighty combat trophies! Daily and weekly seasonal missions, which are selected according to the level of your character, are waiting for you in the Activity Center! Just remember to keep track of your progress, because at 23:00 CET daily missions change, and the progress of unfinished missions is reset. The same happens with weekly missions every Sunday at 23:00 CET.

Now it's time to find out what rewards await you this season! The list of combat trophies includes the epic “Agony” costume, the nightmarish skill “Naughty Ride”, the festive "Chest of Malevolent smirks" with funny emoticons, mystical hairstyles, collectible emoticons, unique minions, new legendary elixirs of unity and experience, valuable buffs, including the most useful buff “Great Intimidation”, a unique event currency “Essence of Horror”, additional sections of the warehouse and other prizes, including the exclusive “Chest of Median Night”!

The chests may contain:

Books:

 Book "Second Chance"
 Book "Underground Speed"

Book "Second Chance"
Instantly resurrects the character's minion and applies the “Invincible” buff for 10 sec. once during the lifetime of the minion.

Book "Underground Speed"
Increases the character's movement speed in the selected dungeons by 10%.

Costumes:

 Puppeteer

 Coviello's Garb
 Punchinello's Garb
 Arlekin's Garb
 Jester's Costume
 Joker
 Valdemar
 Boogeyman
 Hrungnir

Unique powerful relic:

Decorative Skins of the Eternal Forest and Cursed Lands;

as well as: 

 great elixirs of gladiator, unity, and experience;
 special battle scrolls;
 powerful potions;
 precious bars.

 additional slots with daily and weekly missions;

 the possibility of a free hairstyle change at a personal hairdresser.

And after completing all levels of the Season of Activities, an additional reward slot will open for owners of the Battle Pass: get an exclusive “Chest of Median Night” for every 40 points earned. You can do it any number of times during the season!

And don't forget about the recently opened opportunity to give the Battle Pass to any player from 6 level of character as part of your Alliance and game server! You can do it right from the Activity Season menu!

The 11th Season of activities “Triumph of heroes”: bolder to exploits!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30831945/424777ce4e17f45e65dd8751393a380c53c1bd95.png

Warriors of Arinar!

New brave heroes that appeared in Warspear Online at the beginning of autumn caused a serious hype in the ranks of the Sentinels and the Legion! Tirelessly develop new characters or test your strength in a fight with the Beastmaster or the Reaper - whatever your choice, the 11th Season of activities will be very useful! Daily and weekly missions, selected according to the level of your hero, await you in the Activity Center. Just remember that at 00:00 CEST, daily missions change, and the progress of unfinished missions is reset. The same happens with weekly missions every Monday at 00:00 CEST.

This season the list of rewards includes the majestic “Efor” costume, the graceful “Cat Agility” skill, seasonal hairstyles, collectible emoticons, unique minions, new legendary elixirs of unity and experience, valuable buffs, additional sections of the warehouse and many other battle trophies, among which are “Chest of Impunity”!

The chests may contain:

Books:

 Book "Second Chance"
 Book "Underground Speed"

Costumes:

 Black Troll Costume
 Blue Troll Costume
 Green Troll Costume
 Red Troll Costume
 Purple Troll Costume
 Pink Troll Costume

Decorative Skins of the Eternal Forest and Cursed Lands;

Unique powerful relics:

 Icy Relic of Intractability 
 Magic Relic of Resilience
 Terrible Relic of Control 

as well as: 

 great elixirs of gladiator, unity, and experience;
 special battle scrolls;
 powerful potions;
 precious bars.

And for those who dream of filling their bag with useful contents, the Battle Pass will come in handy, which opens a branch of unique trophies and many other additional benefits:

 additional slots with daily and weekly missions;
 an additional slot with a reward upon completion of all levels of the Season;
 access to personal and guild warehouse from the quick access menu;
 freely change hairstyles at the Personal Barber.

And after completing all levels of the Season of Activities, an additional slot with a reward will open for owners of the Battle Pass! Get an exclusive “Chest of Impunity” for every 40 points earned an unlimited number of times until the end of the season! The ability to gift the Battle Pass has been temporarily disabled.

The season starts on September, 12 00:00 CEST, and lasts through October 24, 00:00 CEST.

See you in the game!
AIGRIND

notes.title: Update Warspear Online 11.0: New Legends. Release
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30831945/70409f0181e186dffaee1c8c5f44228078499b6c.png

Dear friends!

The confrontation between the Alliances in Warspear Online continues! To maintain the delicate balance in the War of the Spear, the forces of the Legion and Sentinels called upon the peace makers. And once again the gods responded to the pleas for help, breathing life into those who are destined to become the legends of Arinar... Meet two new character classes - the Beastmaster from the Firstborn faction and the Reaper from the Forsaken faction!

What awaits players in the update 11.0 “New Legends”?

 Two new classes - Beastmaster and Reaper
 Full set of basic and expert skills of new classes
 Special skill mechanics for Beastmaster and Reaper
 Talent branches for Beastmaster and Reaper
 Legendary achievements for new classes
 Two additional slots for characters creation
 Season of activities and Battle Pass
 Ability to gift a Battle Pass
 Update of “Berengar's Tower” dungeon
 Unique items in the Miracle Shop
 New powerful minion
 Gifts for all players

New sources of Knowledge

 Knowledge for every 5 levels of character development
 Knowledge for winning the Arena

Minions

 Upgrade of minions skills
 Improved information window about minion
 Displaying minion skills in the information window about minion

Other changes

 Graphic improvements of dungeons at the initial islands
 Freeing up names of old characters

Hurry to the forum for all the details!

notes.title: Update Warspear Online 11.0: New Legends. Preview
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30831945/c0776b2b57a0bdc07c0ee10b05ae7030c12bc5ec.png

Dear friends!

The news about the upcoming journey to the unknown lands of the Chainless League, which appeared in the midst of the celebration of Warspear Online’s birthday, caused serious excitement among the folks inhabiting Arinar. Fearing that the successful conquest of the Almahad by one of the Alliances might upset the delicate balance in the War for the Spear, the forces of the Legion and the Sentinels called on the makers of peace. And again the gods responded to the pleas for help, breathing life into those who are destined to become the new legends of Arinar…

So, it's time to take a closer look at two new classes! A full set of skills and talents will be available for each of them, so that new heroes can immediately rush into the thick of battle!

Hurry to the forum for all the details!

Instantly resurrects the character's minion and applies the “Invincible” buff for 10 sec. once during the lifetime of the minion.The presence of an extra life will be displayed with an icon next to the minion's health/energy widget.

Increases the character's movement speed in the selected dungeons by 10%.

Costumes:

 Serpent
 Buffon

as well as: 

 great elixirs of gladiator, unity, and experience;

 additional slots with daily and weekly missions;

 the possibility of a free hairstyle change at a Personal Barber.

In addition, after completing all the levels of the Season of Activity, an additional slot with a reward will open for Battle Pass owners! Get the Chest of Times for every 40 points earned an unlimited number of times until the end of the season!

The season will begin on July 25 at 00:00 CEST and will last until September 05 at 00:00 CEST.

See you in the game!

notes.title: Welcome the LVIII Arena season!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30831945/57c84fb993772d25f6831153009a789b672c3e7d.png

Great warriors!

The LVIII season of the Arena intends to become a new development in the history of glorious battles. And all thanks to the new mode "Temple of Seals 4x4".

New mode "Temple of Seals 4x4"

Many of you are already familiar with the mechanics of the Temple of Seals, the main task of which is to score 1000 points, so that your team will win. This can be done in 2 ways: capture and hold seals, and also kill enemy players.

In total, there will be 3 level categories in the new mode: 4-17 \ 18-25 \ 26-32. But even such differences in levels will not prevent you from fighting on equal terms, because the level of the character and equipment will be equal to the highest in the category.
